_comment: Per-client least-privilege tool grants. Only the tools listed here are allowed.

email_only.description: Client needs email read/send only. No shell, no process spawning.

data_processing.description: Client needs file manipulation and scripted data crunching.

offline_compute.description: Pinned fixture-only compute. The host runner supplies an immutable source copy and OS-enforced no-network sandbox.

full_automation.description: Client needs full exec + process. Requires explicit owner sign-off.
